title: Elod's Biome Extension
description: This mod adds biomes, and money (later new dimensions) to Minecraft, it'S not realistic like Biomes O' Plenty, it's more likely fantasy, and it's in early phases of development!
body:
Hey! This is version 1.1.5 (FINALLY **The first Beta version**), and it contains: 

● Money item: If you mine a Money Ore, you get the Money item (also, the Money item, can be crafted to 2 emeralds)

●Money Ore: If you mine it, you get Money item

● New biomes: "Lighting Trees" (obvious functions! :D), and "RedLeaf Forest", you will see what's the special thing in it!

● New advancement: for getting a Money item in your inventory. 

● Creative tab: dedicated inventory tab for Money and future items. 

● Loot: Money is now available as a lootable item. 

For now.
